title: compact-rbac-template-validator-and-kms-telemetry-attenuator
author: Elena Rivera
description: Motivation: customers with large tenant graphs hit policy size limits and slow policy evaluation; we introduce a compact RBACv2 template format plus a server-side validator that enforces checksums and rejects unintentional diffs. Secondary goal: reduce telemetry noise from KMS call metadata by introducing a telemetry attenuator that strips high-entropy key material from ingestion streams while preserving attribution for billing/forensics. Design: 1) New compact template codec (binary-ish compact JSON) and a migration path that supports both expanded and compact templates behind feature flag 'rbacv2.compact_templates'. 2) Validator service in policy-authoring path: computes canonical checksum (sha256 canonical-json) and compares against provided checksum; fails fast with user-visible error and remediation hints when mismatched. 3) KMS telemetry attenuator middleware that redacts sensitive fields (wrappingKeyMaterial, raw_kms_response) while emitting derived metrics (kms_provider, key_id_hash) and an opt-out label for debug modes. 4) Canary rollout: validator enabled for 2% of traffic, monitor 'rbac.template_reject_rate' and 'rbac.checksum_mismatch_total' for 72h before widening. Migration steps and rollback: feature flag switch, Linear ENG-4892 contains migration playbook; rollback is immediate feature flag flip and re-deploy of previous validator version. Checklist: [x] unit tests for encoder/decoder; [x] integration tests for validator against sample tenant policies; [x] E2E canary run; [x] docs: docs/rbac/compact-templates.md; [x] alert rules and dashboards updated. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4892/compact-rbac-template-validator; PR for SDK changes (TS/Python) will follow in separate repos.

release_notes: Adds compact RBACv2 template support with a checksum validator to prevent accidental policy drift; introduces KMS telemetry attenuator to redact high-entropy fields while preserving key attribution; rollout behind feature flag 'rbacv2.compact_templates' (canary first).
